commands.name: dataviz
commands.description: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

commands.name: update-config
commands.description: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by exercising it end-to-end and observing behavior — drive the affected flow, not just tests or typecheck. Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Enable debug logging for this session and help diagnose issues

commands.name: code-review
commands.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's review recipe covers them) at the given effort level (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings up to many, some of them uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review. Pass --max-findings <n> to report up to n findings, or --max-findings all for every finding. The choice stays until you pass --max-findings default. For ultra on a GitHub.com PR target, --post asks to post the finished review’s findings to the PR as a single comment from the user’s GitHub account (not a review; the launch dialog still confirms in interactive sessions, while non-interactive mode posts on the flag alone) and --no-post hides that option.

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Research and plan a large-scale change, then execute it in parallel across 5–30 isolated worktree agents that each open a PR.

commands.name: fewer-permission-prompts

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Health-check the user's Claude Code setup and fix issues: diagnose installation health — what the `claude doctor` terminal diagnostics cover — from local data (duplicate or leftover installs, PATH, unparseable settings files, broken or colliding agent definitions, skills whose frontmatter fails to parse); find unused skills, MCP servers, and plugins versus their context cost and disable dead weight; deduplicate local CLAUDE.md files against checked-in ones; trim checked-in CLAUDE.md files by cutting content a session could derive from the codebase (directory layouts, tech-stack lists, architecture overviews) while keeping gotchas, rationale, and non-standard conventions; migrate always-loaded CLAUDE.md guidance into lazy skills and nested CLAUDE.md files; flag slow hooks and context-heavy extensions; check the installed version is current; make auto mode the default permission mode; and pre-approve frequently denied read-only commands. Use when the user asks for a doctor run, checkup, audit, tune-up, or cleanup of their Claude Code setup or configuration.

commands.name: loop

commands.name: docs
commands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: google-workspace
commands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: computer-use
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step of any request to do something in an app on the person's own computer (Notes, Finder, System Settings, any desktop app), to look at their screen, or for "computer use". Computer use (desktop control) lets Claude take screenshots of the person's desktop and control it with clicks, typing and scrolling through the Claude desktop app; its tools are named mcp__computer-use__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__computer_* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before computer use is turned on for a conversation there may be no such tools, only an enable__mcp__remote-devices__computer tool, which turns it on. It covers turning it on, picking the right tool, the access flow, and the safety rules for tiered apps, links and financial actions. It is not for websites, which go through Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser and their own skills. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: chrome-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses Claude in Chrome, the browser extension whose tools are named mcp__claude-in-chrome__* (also called Chrome, the browser extension, or the external browser) and which acts in the person's real Chrome with their own sign-ins; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__claude-in-chrome tool instead. It covers loading the tools in one ToolSearch call, checking the person's open tabs and working in a new tab, site permissions, GIF recordings, console logs, dialogs to avoid, and when to stop and ask. It is not for the built-in browser (mcp__Claude_Browser__* or mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: built-in-browser
commands.description: Read this skill before the first step that uses the built-in browser, the browser pane inside the Claude desktop app (also called the in-app browser, the browser pane, Claude's browser, or "your own browser"), whose tools are named mcp__Claude_Browser__* when the session runs in the desktop app and mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser__* when a cloud session is linked to the person's computer; before those tools are turned on there may be a single enable__mcp__remote-devices__Claude_Browser tool instead. It covers the pane's persistent sign-ins, tabs and preview_start, reading pages as text, site approvals, what the pane cannot open, and what to do when it cannot be reached. It is not for Claude in Chrome (mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools), which has its own skill, and it does not decide which browser to use. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: anthropic-skills:deep-research
commands.description: Use this skill when the user's prompt requires (1) researching a topic across multiple sources, comparing options or alternatives, analyzing trends or history, understanding markets or industries, or reviewing literature or studies and (2) synthesizing that research into a comprehensive, narrative report. If you're planning to search the web or internal knowledge bases, consider using this skill. This skill coordinates research subagents, so use it only when you have a tool for spawning subagents (the Agent or Task tool); otherwise, research the question directly. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: morning

Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: skill-creator
commands.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pptx
commands.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations as PowerPoint (.pptx) files; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email, summary, or creating a different type of slide deck); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user asks for a PowerPoint or .pptx file, or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. However, when the user asks for a deck, slides, a slide deck, or a presentation without naming a file format, default to using a dedicated slide-deck artifact type or a separate slides skill if this session offers one; otherwise, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: pdf
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill. (claude.ai sync)

commands.name: docx
commands.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx) or Word templates (.dotx). Triggers include: any mention of Microsoft Word Documents, such as 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', 'microsoft doc'. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead, even if they will email or print it. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)

기준 경로: `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain/sale/` · 파일 24개 · `~` = 이름 기반 추정(심볼 확인 실패 또는 소스에 선언 없는 상속·생성 메서드)

## 1. 엔드포인트

| HTTP | 경로 | 핸들러 | 직접 호출 |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/sale-bids` | `SaleBidCommandController#createSaleBid` | `SaleBidCommandService#createSaleBid` |
| DELETE | `/sale-bids/{saleBidId}` | `SaleBidCommandController#deleteSaleBid` | `SaleBidCommandService#deleteSaleBid` |
| POST | `/sale-bids/instant` | `SaleBidCommandController#createInstantSale` | `SaleBidCommandService#createInstantSaleBid` |
| POST | `/sales/{saleId}/shipment` | `SaleCommandController#createSellerShipment` | `SaleCommandService#createSellerShipment` |
| GET | `/sale-bids` | `SaleBidQueryController#getSaleBids` | `SaleBidQueryService#getSaleBids` |
| GET | `/sale-bids/count` | `SaleBidQueryController#getSaleBidStatusCounts` | `SaleBidQueryService#getSaleBidStatusCounts` |
| GET | `/sale-bids/{saleBidId}` | `SaleBidQueryController#getSaleBidDetail` | `SaleBidQueryService#getSaleBidDetail` |

## 2. 호출 사슬 (주입 필드 기준, 컨트롤러 제외)

- `SaleBankAccountCommandService`
  - `createSaleBankAccount` → SaleBankAccountRepository#save~
- `SaleBidCommandService`
  - `createSaleBid` → UserQueryService#findByEmail, ProductSizeQueryService#findById, SaleCommandService#createSale, SaleBidRepository#save~
  - `createInstantSaleBid` → SaleCommandService#createInstantSale, OrderBidQueryService#findById, SaleBidRepository#save~
  - `deleteSaleBid` → SaleBidRepository#findById, SaleCommandService#deleteSale, SaleBidRepository#delete~
- `SaleBidQueryService`
  - `findById` → SaleBidRepository#findById
  - `findByOrderId` → SaleBidRepository#findByOrder_Id
  - `findBySaleId` → SaleBidRepository#findBySale_Id
  - `getSaleBids` → SaleBidRepository#findSaleBidsByFilters
  - `getSaleBidStatusCounts` → SaleBidRepository#countSaleBidsByStatus
  - `getSaleBidDetail` → SaleBidRepository#findSaleBidById
- `SaleBidStatusCountDto`
  - `getPendingRatio` → this#getTotalCount
  - `getMatchedRatio` → this#getTotalCount
  - `getCancelledOrCompletedRatio` → this#getTotalCount
- `SaleCommandService`
  - `createInstantSale` → OrderBidQueryService#findById, UserQueryService#findByEmail, SaleRepository#save~, BankAccountQueryService#getBankAccount, SaleBankAccountCommandService#createSaleBankAccount, NotificationCommandService#createNotification
  - `createSale` → BankAccountQueryService#getBankAccount, SaleRepository#save~, SaleBankAccountCommandService#createSaleBankAccount, NotificationCommandService#createNotification
  - `createSellerShipment` → SellerShipmentCommandService#createSellerShipment, this#updateSaleStatus
  - `updateSaleStatus` → SaleRepository#findById~
  - `deleteSale` → SaleRepository#findById~, SaleRepository#delete~

- `SaleBidQueryController` controller/query/SaleBidQueryController.java · public: getSaleBids, getSaleBidStatusCounts, getSaleBidDetail · 주입: SaleBidQueryService

- `SaleBankAccountCommandService` service/command/SaleBankAccountCommandService.java · public: createSaleBankAccount · 주입: SaleBankAccountRepository
- `SaleBidCommandService` service/command/SaleBidCommandService.java · public: createSaleBid, createInstantSaleBid, deleteSaleBid · 주입: SaleBidRepository, UserQueryService, ProductSizeQueryService, SaleCommandService, OrderBidQueryService
- `SaleCommandService` service/command/SaleCommandService.java · public: createInstantSale, createSale, createSellerShipment, updateSaleStatus, deleteSale · 주입: SaleRepository, OrderBidQueryService, NotificationCommandService, UserQueryService, SellerShipmentCommandService, BankAccountQueryService, SaleBankAccountCommandService

### service-query (1)

- `SaleBidQueryService` service/query/SaleBidQueryService.java · public: findById, findByOrderId, findBySaleId, getSaleBids, getSaleBidStatusCounts, getSaleBidDetail · 주입: SaleBidRepository

### repository (3)

- `SaleBankAccountRepository` (interface) repository/SaleBankAccountRepository.java · extends/implements JpaRepository
- `SaleBidRepository` (interface) repository/SaleBidRepository.java · extends/implements JpaRepository, SaleBidRepositoryCustom · public: findById, findByOrder_Id, findBySale_Id

### entity (5)

- `BidStatus` (enum) entity/BidStatus.java
- `Sale` entity/Sale.java · extends/implements BaseTimeEntity · public: assignSaleBankAccount, assignSaleBid, assignPayment, assignSellerShipment, updateStatus
- `SaleBankAccount` entity/SaleBankAccount.java · extends/implements BaseTimeEntity · public: assignSale
- `SaleBid` entity/SaleBid.java · extends/implements BaseTimeEntity · public: assignSale, assignOrder, markAsInstantSale, updateStatus
- `SaleStatus` (enum) entity/SaleStatus.java · public: canTransitionTo

### dto (5)

- `InstantSaleRequestDto` dto/InstantSaleRequestDto.java
- `SaleBidRequestDto` dto/SaleBidRequestDto.java
- `SaleBidResponseDto` dto/SaleBidResponseDto.java
- `SaleBidStatusCountDto` dto/SaleBidStatusCountDto.java

### 다른 도메인 참조 (import·주입 기준)

- **notification**: `NotificationCategory` ← SaleCommandService; `NotificationCommandService` ← SaleCommandService; `NotificationType` ← SaleCommandService
- **order**: `BidStatus` ← SaleCommandService; `Order` ← SaleBid; `OrderBid` ← SaleBidCommandService, SaleCommandService; `OrderBidQueryService` ← SaleBidCommandService, SaleCommandService
- **payment**: `Payment` ← Sale
- **product**: `ProductSize` ← Sale, SaleBid, SaleBidCommandService, SaleCommandService; `ProductSizeQueryService` ← SaleBidCommandService
- **shipment**: `SellerShipment` ← Sale, SaleCommandService; `SellerShipmentCommandService` ← SaleCommandService
- **user**: `BankAccountQueryService` ← SaleCommandService; `User` ← Sale, SaleBid, SaleBidCommandService, SaleCommandService; `UserQueryService` ← SaleBidCommandService, SaleCommandService

### 이 도메인을 참조하는 다른 도메인

- **global**: Sale, SaleBid, SaleBidRepository, SaleRepository, SaleStatus
- **order**: Sale, SaleBid, SaleBidQueryService
- **payment**: Sale, SaleBid, SaleBidQueryService, SaleStatus
- **shipment**: BidStatus, Sale, SaleBid, SaleBidQueryService, SaleRepository, SaleStatus
- **warehouseStorage**: Sale

## 4. JPA 엔티티 연관

- `Sale` @Entity · extends BaseTimeEntity
  - seller: @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY) @JoinColumn(name = "seller_id") → `User` [user]
  - productSize: @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY) @JoinColumn(name = "product_size_id") → `ProductSize` [product]
  - payment: @OneToOne(mappedBy = "sale", cascade = CascadeType.ALL, orphanRemoval = true) → `Payment` [payment]

# 즉시 구매 처리 흐름 (코드 기준 실제 동작)

경로 약어: `D` = `src/main/java/com/fream/back/domain`

## 1. 진입 API, 처리 단계, 동기/비동기, 응답 ID

- 진입점은 `POST /order-bids/instant`이다. 클래스 `@RequestMapping("/order-bids")` + `@PostMapping("/instant")`. 요청 바디는 `InstantOrderRequestDto`(saleBidId, addressId, warehouseStorage, paymentRequest). 근거: `D/order/controller/command/OrderBidCommandController.java:89-90`, `D/order/dto/InstantOrderRequestDto.java:18-29`
  - (`/orders/{orderId}/process-payment-shipment` 는 Kafka 비동기 경로이지만 즉시 구매와 무관하다. 즉시 구매는 이 경로를 쓰지 않는다. `D/order/controller/command/OrderCommandController.java:42-54`)
- 처리 단계 (모두 한 요청 스레드 안, 하나의 `@Transactional`):
  1. 컨트롤러가 이메일을 꺼내고 `enrichPaymentRequest`로 `userEmail`을 채우고 `orderId=null`로 둔다. `OrderBidCommandController.java:92-98, 119-122`
  2. `OrderBidCommandService#createInstantOrderBid` (`@Transactional`): 입력 검증 → 구매자 조회 → SaleBid 조회(+Sale 존재 검증) → `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder` → OrderBid 생성. `D/order/service/command/OrderBidCommandService.java:118-143`
  3. `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder` (`@Transactional`): 주소 조회 → Order 저장 → 결제요청에 orderId 주입 → OrderItem → OrderShipment → SaleBid 매칭(+flush) → 창고 상태 → 결제. `D/order/service/command/OrderCommandService.java:219-311`
  4. 결제 `PaymentCommandService#processPayment` 안에서 알림 생성 + Sale 상태 변경. `D/payment/service/command/PaymentCommandService.java:57-83`
  5. 마지막에 OrderBid 생성/저장. `OrderBidCommandService.java:189-207`
- **동기 처리**다. Kafka 발행/구독이 전혀 없다(이 경로에서 `OrderEventProducer`/`KafkaTemplate` 호출 없음). 컨트롤러는 서비스가 끝날 때까지 기다려 `200 OK`를 반환한다. `OrderBidCommandController.java:101-109` (HTTP 202가 아니라 200 + "즉시 구매가 성공적으로 처리되었습니다.")
- 응답 data의 `Long`은 **주문(Order) ID**이다. 서비스가 OrderBid를 반환하지만 컨트롤러가 `.getId()`가 아니라 변수명 `orderId`로 받고 있어 이름은 orderId이지만, 실제 값은 `orderBid.getId()` 즉 **OrderBid의 ID**다. `OrderBidCommandController.java:101-107` — `createInstantOrderBid`의 반환 타입이 `OrderBid`(`OrderBidCommandService.java:119`)이고 `.getId()`는 OrderBid의 PK이다. 즉 메시지·변수명과 달리 응답 ID는 **OrderBid ID**이며 Order ID와 값이 다를 수 있다.

## 2. 새로 생성되는 엔티티와 상태 변화 순서

생성 순서와 각 단계 직후 상태:

| 순서 | 동작 | 직후 상태 | 근거 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Order` 생성·저장 (totalAmount = SaleBid.bidPrice) | Order = `PENDING_PAYMENT` | `OrderCommandService.java:241-247` |
| 2 | `OrderItem` 생성 (quantity 1, price = bidPrice) | Order 상태 그대로 `PENDING_PAYMENT` | `OrderCommandService.java:255-256`, `D/order/service/command/OrderItemCommandService.java:45-52` |
| 3 | `OrderShipment` 생성 (주소는 addressId로 조회한 값) | Shipment = `PENDING` | `OrderCommandService.java:238, 264-271`, `D/shipment/service/command/OrderShipmentCommandService.java:61-68` |
| 4 | `saleBid.assignOrder(order)` + `updateStatus(MATCHED)` + `flush` | SaleBid = `MATCHED`, `saleBid.order`=Order | `OrderCommandService.java:279-283`, `D/sale/entity/SaleBid.java:83-93` |
| 5 | (판매 건이 창고 보관이면) 창고 상태 변경 | WarehouseStorage = `ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER` | `OrderCommandService.java:289-301` |
| 6 | `Payment` 생성 (Card/Account/General) | 결제수단별로 다름 (3번 참조) | `PaymentCommandService.java:67-80` |
| 7 | 알림 2건(구매자·판매자) 생성 후 `Sale` → `SOLD` | Sale = `SOLD` (생성 시 `PENDING_SHIPMENT`였음) | `PaymentCommandService.java:391-405`, `D/sale/service/command/SaleCommandService.java:108` |
| 8 | `OrderBid` 생성 (status `MATCHED`, `isInstantPurchase=true`, order·sale 연결) | OrderBid = `MATCHED` | `OrderBidCommandService.java:192-206`, `D/order/entity/OrderBid.java:49-52, 60-82` |

세부:
- 7번에서 `orderBid`는 아직 만들어지기 전이라 `order.getOrderBid()`가 null이다. 그래서 `saleBidQueryService.findByOrderId`로 SaleBid를 찾아(4번에서 flush되어 조회됨) Sale을 얻는 분기를 탄다. `PaymentCommandService.java:388-406`, `D/sale/service/query/SaleBidQueryService.java:26-29`
- `Sale.updateStatus`는 `SaleStatus.canTransitionTo` 검사를 하지 않으므로 `PENDING_SHIPMENT → SOLD`가 그대로 들어간다. (전이표상 `PENDING_SHIPMENT`는 `IN_TRANSIT`으로만 가능) `D/sale/entity/Sale.java:73-75`, `D/sale/entity/SaleStatus.java:15-25`
- 판매 입찰의 현재 상태(이미 MATCHED인지)는 검증하지 않는다. `OrderBidCommandService.java:172-184` — 이미 매칭된 SaleBid에도 다시 즉시 구매가 가능하다.
- Order 상태는 어디서도 `PAYMENT_COMPLETED` 등으로 바뀌지 않는다 (5번 참조).

## 3. 결제 수단별 결과, 성공 여부, 카드 결제 실패 시

공통 사전 검증: orderId 일치, 이메일 일치, 금액>0. `PaymentCommandService.java:117-145`. 결제 유형 분기: `PaymentCommandService.java:67-80`. 금액이 SaleBid 가격과 같은지는 검사하지 않는다(요청의 `paidAmount`를 그대로 사용).

| 수단 | 동작 | 생성된 Payment 상태 | 근거 |
|---|---|---|---|
| CARD | PaymentInfo 조회 → PortOne API로 실제 카드 결제 요청 → CardPayment 저장. 응답 `status`가 `"success"`면 `PAID`로 변경 | 성공 시 `PAID`+success=true. `"success"`가 아니면 `PENDING` 그대로 | `PaymentCommandService.java:166-208` |
| ACCOUNT | 은행명 검증 후 외부 호출 없이 AccountPayment 저장 | 항상 `PENDING` | `PaymentCommandService.java:244-262` |
| GENERAL | impUid 비어있지 않으면 외부 검증 없이 저장 | 항상 `PAID`, success=true | `PaymentCommandService.java:297-316` |

- **즉시 구매는 결제 성공 여부와 무관하게 "끝까지 성공"한다.** `OrderCommandService#createInstantOrder`는 `processPayment`의 반환값을 사용하지도 않고(`payment.isSuccess()`/상태 확인 없음), `order.assignPayment`나 Order 상태 변경도 하지 않는다. `OrderCommandService.java:303-311`. 반면 Kafka 경로(`OrderEventConsumer`)는 `!payment.isSuccess()`면 예외를 던지는데(`D/order/service/kafka/OrderEventConsumer.java:171-176`) 즉시 구매 경로에는 그 검사가 없다.
- 계좌이체(`PENDING`)여도 Sale은 `SOLD`가 되고 구매자·판매자에게 "결제가 완료되었습니다" 알림이 나간다. `PaymentCommandService.java:83, 403-405, 434-456`. 입금 확인 같은 후속 처리 코드는 이 경로에 없다.
- 주의: `Payment.isSuccess`는 `Card/Account/GeneralPayment` 생성자가 `setPaidAmount`를 호출하면서 `paidAmount>0`이면 true가 된다. `D/payment/entity/Payment.java:60-63`, `CardPayment.java:38`, `AccountPayment.java:28`, `GeneralPayment.java:30`. 따라서 ACCOUNT(`PENDING`)도 `isSuccess=true`이고, 카드 `"success"`가 아닌 경우도 `isSuccess=true`+`PENDING`일 수 있다 (`isSuccess`와 `status`가 불일치).
- **PortOne이 카드 결제를 실패로 응답하면** 응답 형태에 따라 둘로 갈린다:
  1. HTTP 비200이거나 body의 `code != 0` → `PaymentProcessingException`을 던진다. `D/payment/portone/PortOneApiClient.java:270-275`. 이 예외가 `PaymentCommandService`(`:89-94, 218-219`)를 거쳐 `OrderCommandService`에서 `OrderPaymentProcessingFailedException`으로 감싸져(`OrderCommandService.java:306-309`) 던져지고 `OrderBidCommandService`가 그대로 재던진다(`:145-146, 212-218`). 하나의 트랜잭션이므로 **Order, OrderItem, OrderShipment, SaleBid 매칭이 전부 롤백**되고 에러 응답이 반환된다. 알림·Sale SOLD도 만들어지지 않는다(예외가 그 전에 발생). 통신 오류(`RestClientException`)도 `PaymentApiException`으로 같은 결과. `PortOneApiClient.java:288-290`
  2. HTTP 200 + `code == 0` 이지만 `response.status`가 `"success"`가 아닌 경우(`failed` 등) → 예외 없이 `CardPayment`가 `PENDING`(isSuccess는 위 이유로 true)으로 저장된다. `PaymentCommandService.java:203-208`. 이후 구매자·판매자 알림이 나가고 Sale이 `SOLD`가 되고 OrderBid `MATCHED`가 만들어져 **200 OK "즉시 구매가 성공적으로 처리되었습니다"로 끝난다.** 실패가 걸러지지 않는 결함성 동작이다.
- 그 밖에 롤백되는 경우: 주소 조회 실패, 창고 상태 변경 실패(`OrderCommandService.java:295-301`), SaleBid 없음 등.

## 4. 알림 수신자, 시점, 방식

- 수신자는 **구매자와 판매자 각 1명**이다. `PaymentCommandService#sendNotifications`:
  - 구매자(`order.getUser()`): "결제가 완료되었습니다. 주문 ID: {orderId}"
  - 판매자(`sale.getSeller()`): "구매자가 결제를 완료하였습니다. 판매 ID: {saleId}"
  - 둘 다 `NotificationCategory.SHOPPING`, `NotificationType.BID`. `PaymentCommandService.java:434-456`
- 시점: 요청 처리 중, 결제 Payment 저장 직후이자 Sale을 `SOLD`로 바꾸기 직전(같은 트랜잭션 안, 동기). `PaymentCommandService.java:83, 403-405`. 응답이 나가기 전이다. 알림이 실패해도 예외를 삼키므로(`PaymentCommandService.java:421-425, 457-461`) 구매는 계속 진행된다.
- 방식: `NotificationCommandService#createNotification`이 (1) DB에 `Notification` 저장 후 (2) Redis에 `WebSocket:User:{email}` 키가 있는 사용자에게만 STOMP `convertAndSendToUser(email, "/queue/notifications", dto)`로 실시간 전송한다. 연결이 없으면 저장만 되고 조회로 확인한다. `D/notification/service/command/NotificationCommandService.java:44-59, 37-39, 297-323`
- Kafka `notification-topic`/WebSocket `/topic/order/{id}` 알림(`OrderEventConsumer#sendSuccessNotification`)은 즉시 구매 경로에서는 발생하지 않는다 — 그 컨슈머는 `order-processing-topic` 이벤트에서만 호출된다. `OrderEventConsumer.java:55-96`. (참고: `notification-topic` 구독자도 소스에 없음.)
- 판매 건 생성 시의 알림(`SaleCommandService#createSale`)은 판매 등록 시점의 것으로, 즉시 구매 시점의 알림이 아니다. `SaleCommandService.java:125`

## 5. 최종 주문 상태와 "창고 보관" 선택 시 차이

- **주문의 최종 상태는 `PENDING_PAYMENT` (결제 대기)이다.** `createInstantOrder`는 Order를 `PENDING_PAYMENT`로 만들고(`OrderCommandService.java:241-245`) 이후 `updateStatus`를 한 번도 호출하지 않는다(`OrderCommandService.java:219-319`). 결제가 `PAID`여도, 응답이 "성공"이어도 Order는 결제 완료/준비중/완료로 가지 않는다. `PAYMENT_COMPLETED`, `PREPARING`, `COMPLETED` 등으로 바꾸는 코드는 `processPaymentAndShipment`(`OrderCommandService.java:163-177`)와 Kafka 컨슈머(`OrderEventConsumer.java:195-220`)에만 있고 즉시 구매 경로는 호출하지 않는다. 또한 `Order.payment` 필드도 설정하지 않는다(반환 값 미사용, `:305`; 단 `payment.order`는 `assignOrder`로 설정됨, `PaymentCommandService.java:200, 258, 311`).
  - 한편 같은 요청으로 SaleBid=`MATCHED`, OrderBid=`MATCHED`, Sale=`SOLD`로 바뀌므로 주문 상태와 불일치한다.
- **구매자의 "창고 보관" 선택(`warehouseStorage`)은 즉시 구매에서 실제로 무시된다.** 값은 컨트롤러 → `createInstantOrderBid(..., isWarehouseStorage, ...)` → `createInstantOrder(..., isWarehouseStorage, ...)`로 전달되지만(`OrderBidCommandController.java:105`, `OrderBidCommandService.java:137`) `createInstantOrder` 본문에서 이 파라미터를 읽는 곳이 없다(`OrderCommandService.java:219-319`; `isWarehouseStorage` 사용 위치는 주석/시그니처뿐, 코드상 `:292`의 `sale.isWarehouseStorage()`는 **판매자 Sale**의 필드).
  - 그 결과 `createOrderStorage`(구매자용 WarehouseStorage 생성, `IN_STORAGE`)나 `IN_WAREHOUSE`/`COMPLETED` 상태 전이는 일어나지 않는다. 창고 보관 여부에 관계없이 Order는 `PENDING_PAYMENT`, 배송정보(OrderShipment `PENDING`)도 동일하게 만들어진다.
  - 창고와 관련해 실제로 달라지는 것은 **판매자가 창고 보관으로 올린 Sale인 경우**뿐이다: 그 Sale의 WarehouseStorage가 `ASSOCIATED_WITH_ORDER`로 바뀐다(`OrderCommandService.java:291-294`, `D/warehouseStorage/service/command/WarehouseStorageCommandService.java:117-133`). 해당 보관 정보가 없으면 `WarehouseStorageNotFoundException`(`D/warehouseStorage/service/query/WarehouseStorageQueryService.java:30-33`)으로 전체가 롤백된다.
- 비교: 별도 경로 `process-payment-shipment`(Kafka)에서는 창고 보관 선택 시 `createOrderStorage` 후 `PREPARING → IN_WAREHOUSE → COMPLETED`까지 가고(`OrderEventConsumer.java:197-212`), 일반 배송이면 `PREPARING`에서 끝난다(`:214-219`). 즉시 구매는 이 로직을 타지 않는다.
